notes: No amount error. p4 prints General Fund Taxes 16,059,678 (same on p5 schedule), Inheritance Fund 1,320,981, Nonmajor Funds 391,150, Total 17,771,809; the three add up exactly to the total. The receipts[] amount 16,059,680 is not a misprint or a rounding: its computed says General Fund 16,059,678 (p4) + Juvenile Diversion Fund Taxes 2 (p10), which is exact (16,059,678 + 2). Inheritance 1,320,981 IS present as its own receipts[] row (inheritance tax) and detail row (p6). Nonmajor 391,150 is not one row but is fully carried as pieces: 2 (inside the 16,059,680 row) + lodging 261,398 (130,699 + 130,699, p10) + 911 funds 129,750 (55,449 + 74,301, p11) = 391,150; receipts pieces total 17,771,809 exactly. detail[] has every printed fund cell separately (16,059,678; 1,320,981; 2; 130,699; 130,699; 55,449; 74,301). No change proposed under the amount-only brief. Not amount issues, noticed only: FY2024 (model) records one receipts row per printed fund cell, all labelled 'Taxes' (General 14,725,509; Juvenile Diversion 8; each 911 fund; each Visitor fund), whereas FY2025 merges General + Juvenile Diversion, the two Visitor funds and the two 911 funds and uses labels 'Inheritance Fund Taxes', 'Visitors Promotion and Visitors Improvement Funds Taxes', '911 Emergency Management and E911 Wireless Service Funds Taxes' (the 2026-11-04 rule says pieces carry the printed row label 'Taxes', never '<Fund> Taxes'); detail fund names are 'General'/'Inheritance' vs 'General Fund'/'Inheritance Fund' in FY2023/24. If FY2025 is to match FY2024 exactly, the per-cell printed amounts above (pp4, 10, 11) are the ones to use.
